claim: Cross-register check to 2026-10-07 across Switzerland, Belgium, Austria, Czechia and Poland (plus Ireland and Germany per the scraper) finds no cross-border merger, division, conversion, capital reduction, dissolution or branch closure for any FL entity after the Spanish holdco merger, and Foot Locker Dutch Holdings is not named as counterparty anywhere. The operating companies' registered owners are unchanged Dutch B.V.s (CZ: Foot Locker Europe B.V. 109/120 + Foot Locker Netherlands B.V. 11/120; AT: Foot Locker Europe B.V. 100%; PL: FL Ventures B.V. 100%). The Spanish merger therefore removed an intermediate holding company; it did not move any operating company.

claim: VERIFIER-FOUND (correcting scraper finding F5): the Dutch Staatscourant DOES carry cross-border merger announcements in 2026. The overheid.nl SRU repository shows dozens of 'Grensoverschrijdende fusie' notices dated 10-Sep to 7-Oct-2026, including Spanish S.L.U. into Dutch B.V. holdco mergers of the same shape as FL's (e.g. 'Marbefixa S.L.U. en Marbetwo Holding B.V.', 30-Sep-2026). None names Foot Locker, Dutch Holdings or Europe Holdings, and no Staatscourant title containing 'Locker' has appeared since Sep-2025. No such merger titles are visible for Apr-Aug 2026, so the repository cannot show whether the FL Spanish merger (Mar-Jun 2026) had a Dutch notice; but from Sep-2026 the Staatscourant is a free watch channel for any further FL leg into a Dutch B.V.
data_point: SRU, officielepublicaties, title 'grensoverschrijdende fusie', date >= 2026-03-01: 104 records, with at least 27 cross-border merger notices dated 2026-09-10 to 2026-10-07; 0 for Apr-Jun and Jul-early Sep 2026 windows; 0 FL / Dutch Holdings hits.
